title: Senior Advocate
description:
GUNNJJ REALTY LLP

Job Description – Senior Advocate (Legal Counsel)

We are seeking a highly professional, experienced, responsible and versatile Senior Advocate to manage the company’s legal affairs, RERA compliance, documentation and regulatory requirements, providing end-to-end legal support across real estate, hospitality and other business operations.

1. Key Roles & Responsibilities

* Legal Advisory: Provide strategic legal guidance on real estate, hospitality and other business matters.
* RERA Compliance: Handle RERA registrations, filings, disclosures, regulatory compliance and project-related legal requirements.
* Documentation & Contracts: Draft, review and vet agreements, contracts, MOUs, lease deeds and other legal documents.
* Regulatory Compliance: Ensure adherence to applicable laws, regulations and statutory requirements, including RERA.
* Legal Coordination: Liaise with courts, government authorities, RERA officials, auditors, consultants and external legal counsel.
* Litigation & Case Management: Manage ongoing legal matters, attend court hearings, monitor case progress and ensure timely follow-ups.
* Property Due Diligence: Conduct title searches, title verification, ownership checks and property-related legal investigations.
* Property & Regulatory Matters: Handle property registrations, mutation, conversion, permissions, approvals and related documentation.
* Legal Records & Reporting: Maintain legal documents, case files, compliance records and provide regular updates to management.

2. Candidate Profile & Requirements

* Qualified Advocate enrolled with the Bar Council, with significant professional experience, preferably in real estate and RERA matters.
* Strong knowledge of real estate, RERA, property, contract, corporate and regulatory laws.
* Excellent communication and negotiation skills in English, Hindi and Bengali.
* Highly professional, presentable, courteous and confident.
* Well-organised, detail-oriented and capable of handling multiple responsibilities.
* Proactive, disciplined, reliable and accountable.
* Comfortable with office work, field visits, court proceedings and coordination with government authorities.

3. Employment Details

* Company: GUNNJJ REALTY LLP
* Position: Senior Advocate (Legal Counsel)
* Working Days: Monday to Saturday
* Office Timings: 10:00 AM – 7:00 PM
* Monthly Salary:
* ₹16,000 – Candidates with 5 years of professional experience.
* ₹20,000 – Candidates with 7 years of professional experience.
* Minimum Employment Commitment: 12 Months
* Work Location: Kolkata
* Nature of Work: Full-Time | Office & Field

4. Mandatory Professional Expectations

* Regular attendance and punctuality are mandatory.
* Strict workplace discipline and professional conduct must be maintained.
* Confidentiality, integrity and accountability are essential.
* Timely completion of assigned legal responsibilities and follow-ups is expected.
* A minimum 12-month employment commitment is required.

Pay: ₹16,000.00 - ₹20,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Manager - Legal (Transactions)
description:
**Position: Manager – Legal (Transactions)**

**Location:** Kolkata  
**Experience:** 5–10 Years

**Role Summary**

We are seeking a **high-calibre Transaction Lawyer** whose core expertise lies in **structuring, drafting, negotiating, and successfully closing complex commercial and real estate transactions**. The ideal candidate should have a proven track record of independently handling high-value transactions, delivering commercially viable legal solutions, and enabling seamless deal execution while effectively managing legal and business risks.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead and manage **end-to-end commercial and real estate transactions**.
* Draft, review, negotiate, and finalize a wide range of agreements, including **Land Acquisition Agreements, Land Aggregation transactions, Joint Development Agreements (JDAs), Development Management Agreements (DMAs), Sale Deeds, Conveyance Deeds, Lease Deeds, Development Agreements, MoUs, NDAs, and other commercial contracts**.
* Structure transactions from a legal and commercial perspective to facilitate smooth deal closure.
* Conduct legal due diligence, title verification, risk assessment, and provide transaction advisory.
* Work closely with business teams, consultants, government authorities, and external counsel to drive timely completion of transactions.
* Ensure compliance with all applicable statutory and regulatory requirements while safeguarding the Company's legal interests.

**Qualification & Candidate Profile**

* **LL.B. from a reputed law school/university with a minimum of 70% marks or CGPA 8.0/10 (or equivalent). Candidates from premier law institutions will be preferred.**
* **5–10 years of core transactional legal experience**, preferably with a leading real estate developer, infrastructure company, or reputed corporate/law firm.
* Demonstrated expertise in **transaction structuring, contract drafting, negotiations, legal due diligence, and deal execution**.
* Strong commercial acumen, exceptional legal drafting, analytical reasoning, and negotiation skills.
* Ability to independently manage multiple high-value transactions in a fast-paced environment.

Interested candidates can share their CV at:nitu@advancetalentservices.com

Application Question(s):

* Do you have experience working with real estate developer, infrastructure company, or reputed corporate/law firm?
* What is your fixed current salary (CTC) per annum?
* What is your fixed expected salary (CTC) per annum?
* What is your notice period?
* From which school/university have you completed your LLB?
* What is the % marks or CGPA or equivalent have you scored in LLB?
* Where in Kolkata do you reside?

Experience:

* core transactional legal: 5 years (Preferred)

Work Location: In person
